name: Ben Tre Museum
kicker: French-front museum of the coconut country
summary: French-front museum on Hùng Vương: walk the coconut rooms in a morning for the wood instruments. The set by Võ Văn Bá is the first traditional instrument group in Vietnam made from coconut. Come after breakfast on đường 30 Tháng 4, and before the boat. Hours and the fee are Check on arrival.
getThere: Walk from đường 30 Tháng 4 to 146 Hùng Vương.
heroCaption: The French front of Bảo tàng Bến Tre, with the steps and blue shutters
gettingThere: From đường 30 Tháng 4, walk to 146 Hùng Vương, phường An Hội. The morning in town puts this door after breakfast and before the boat.
Inside, the rooms cover the history of the coconut country. The coconut-wood instrument set by Võ Văn Bá is the first traditional instrument group in Vietnam made from coconut.

legs.heading: From đường 30 Tháng 4
legs.body: Walk to 146 Hùng Vương. Hours and the fee are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the town bank
legs.body: The same walk, along Hùng Vương. Ask for 146, in phường An Hội.
